ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision platform using pose estimation to detect musculoskeletal strain risks during remote desk work.
ideas.title: BioKinetic: Ergonomic Workplace Posture AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of CricketVision_AI by combining MediaPipe and a classification model to solve a real biomechanical safety challenge.

ideas.pitch: An interactive supply chain dashboard that ingests logistics parameters to calculate and optimize transport carbon footprints.
ideas.title: SupplyRoute Carbon Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of the IBM carbon footprint project by giving judges concrete, visualized environmental metrics.

ideas.pitch: A transaction graph analyzer that highlights suspicious money-laundering clusters using lightweight graph intelligence.
ideas.title: FinGraph AML: Entity Network Risk Screener
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex data visualization to impress judges with enterprise-grade financial crime prevention mechanics.

ideas.pitch: An automated video indexing tool that extracts keyframes, transcribes audio, and makes long lecture or seminar archives searchable.
ideas.title: DocuPulse AI: Unstructured Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors LibrAI's award-winning approach of transforming unstructured video archives into clean, highly searchable data assets.

ideas.pitch: A simulated IoT dashboard tracking live power grid metrics with predictive anomaly alerts for urban energy consumption.
ideas.title: EcoGrid IoT: Smart Energy Monitoring Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the IoT innovation domain with a working live-stream demo of sensor telemetry and automated threshold alerts.
